name: ccvl-apply
title_zh: 对着真实职位空缺，产出带证据链的整套申请材料
tagline_zh: 别再用同一份简历海投了。输入具体职位空缺，它逐条核对你的经历与岗位要求，生成申请配置、定制简历摘要。
tagline_en: Stop mass-applying with the same CV. Feed it a concrete vacancy, and it cross-checks your history against each.
desc_en: Evaluate a concrete vacancy and create its evidence-backed application.toml, tailored CV Summary, six cover-letter paragraphs, and five highlights.
why_zh: 它不写泛泛而谈的求职信。机制上先解析职位描述为可验证条目，再逐条匹配你的经历。
why_en: No generic cover letters. It parses the job ad into checkable requirements, matches each against your history, and produces.
limit_zh: 需要你预先提供结构化的个人经历库（如 JSON 格式的简历数据），否则无法匹配证据；只覆盖英文职位描述。
limit_en: Requires a structured personal history (e.g., JSON resume) to match evidence; only handles English job postings—others are skipped; outputs drafts.
title_en: Turn a real job posting into evidence-backed application.
